research_question: When can an empty GitHub Actions workflow-run query support a claim that no workflow ran for an exact commit?

primary: GitHub REST Actions workflow-runs endpoint documentation
source_status.connector_constraint: The available fetch_commit_workflow_runs connector filters to pull_request events and returns the first page only.

finding: An empty result proves absence only when the observation covers all trigger events, follows every pagination page, uses exact commit binding, and rejects cross-commit contamination. Otherwise absence remains unproven.
evidence_strength: strong for deterministic assessment semantics; not yet evidence that a repository query was actually exhaustive
uncertainty: The current connector cannot enumerate all events and all pages.
The assessor depends on trustworthy query-coverage metadata supplied by the enumerator.
falsification_route: Provide a dataset marked exhaustive that omits a workflow run discoverable through a complete REST traversal, or demonstrate that GitHub returns workflow runs outside the enumerated pages/events for the same exact commit.
